title: Evidence-based medicine
lead: Ask a clinical question in your own words — the page shows what PubMed has on it, sorted by strength of study design. The conclusion stays yours: this shows the field of literature, it does not make the decision.
placeholderAsk: For example: does metformin prevent diabetes in people with prediabetes?
rawHint: The query goes to PubMed as is — AND, OR, NOT, [tiab], [mh] are supported. Publication-type filters are added automatically.
waitAsk: Parsing the question and searching PubMed — this takes 10–20 seconds.
errorGeneric: The search failed. Please try again.
verdictNote: This describes what was found, not how effective the treatment is.
widened: The precise query found nothing — the search was repeated with a broader one.
